## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md`

- names `packages/types/src/index.ts` → `packages/types/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > **`GanttConfig` itself gains nine members and is a published type**, exported by name from `packages/types/src/index.ts`: `lockField`, `objectField`, `summaryExtent`, `defaultCollapsedDepth`, `borderColorField`, `dependencyTypes`, `timeZone`, `exportFileName`, `interactions`. The entry file's diff is empty only because the export list already named the type — the widening happened at the declaration.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `53374dc07` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1102 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1604 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35108585199)

```

```

Inputs judged from: objectui#8800 (body + all 7 comments; the ruling is comment `5689196791`, director batch #137 item 2, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-15, **letter A**), PR #9622 (body, files, the one commit, check runs), the tree at the head sha in a fresh clone, and objectui#8178 (body + all 9 comments) for the pin this diff rewrites. The PR's fork point is `3ecc369bf` (merge-base with the base ref); the real diff is the 5 files GitHub lists, 395+/86−. Every reading below was re-derived in that clone, not taken from the PR body.

### ① Derived judgments — each change to the accept set or public surface, against the ruling

The ruling authorises exactly: (i) the `AIInsightsSchema` declaration goes; (ii) its `@object-ui/types` barrel export goes; (iii) the objectui#8178 exclusion pin at `ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` :115 / :120 (`Equal<…>`) is rewritten by this ruling; (iv) B and C refused. Execution: changeset `minor` on `@object-ui/types`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 disposition line, `spec-property-retirement` shape as #8178.

| # | change in the diff | ruled? | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/types/src/ai.ts`: `export interface AIInsightsSchema` (and its `type: 'ai-insights'` discriminant, `objectName`, `data`, `config`, `insights[]`, `loading`, `autoRefresh`, `refreshInterval`) deleted; a JSDoc tombstone stands in its place. One hunk, nothing else in the file moved. | (i) | **right** — verified on the built artifact (below). Narrows exactly the unit the ruling named, no more: `AIFormAssistSchema`, `AIRecommendationsSchema`, `NLQuerySchema` and the support types `AIConfig` / `AIFieldSuggestion` / `AIRecommendationItem` / `NLQueryResult` are byte-untouched, and each support type still has readers in `ai.ts` (5 / 3 / 3 / 3 occurrences), so nothing is orphaned by the removal. |
| 2 | `packages/types/src/index.ts`: `AIInsightsSchema,` removed from the `export type { … } from './ai.js'` block; a comment stands where it was. One hunk. | (ii) | **right** — the barrel is the published face; head `dist/index.d.ts` names the symbol 0 times (control `AIRecommendationsSchema` 1). |
| 3 | `ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts`: the exclusion paragraph replaced and `assertionInsightsObjectNameUntouched = Expect<Equal<import('../ai').AIInsightsSchema['objectName'], string \| undefined>>` removed. | (iii) | **right, and exactly as narrow as ruled** — see the pin question below. |
| 4 | New pin `ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts` (two `@ts-expect-error` legs on `../ai` and `../index`, source-text matchers, tree-wide `git grep` census with exclusions listed beside their reasons, a premise leg on `AnyComponentSchema`, a zod-mirror structural leg). | shape clause | **right** — it changes no accept set and no public surface; it is the executable half of the tombstone. Both legs are in a real `tsc` program: `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin (1) and the 8178 pin (1), control for a nonexistent file 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0; `vitest run` on both pins 2 files / 16 tests pass. Tree-scoped with `REPO_ROOT` rooted at the file — the same shape three sibling pins in this directory already use (`alert-dialog-footer-keys-refusal-7963`, `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344`, `page-breadcrumbs-refusal-8871`); this repo has no `cross-package-test-inputs` registry to declare a radius in. |
| 5 | `.changeset/8800-retire-ai-insights.md` | execution clause | judged under ② — level and package set right; one execution-line shortfall recorded there, non-blocking. |

Nothing else in the diff touches an accept set or a public surface: no renderer, registration, zod file, doc, skill or README moved, and the head census (`git grep`) finds `AIInsightsSchema` / `ai-insights` only in the five diff files plus the pending #8178 changeset's prose. No package transitively republishes `@object-ui/types` (`export * from '@object-ui/types'` / `export type *`: 0 hits under `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src`), so `@object-ui/types` is the only published surface that moved.

**Built-artifact readings** (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`, clean, exit 0 incl. `check-dist-completeness`, at the head and at the fork point in a second worktree):

| reading on `dist/**/*.d.ts` | base `3ecc369bf` | head `52bdbe331` |
|---|---|---|
| `interface AIInsightsSchema` | 1 | **0** |
| member `^\s+type: 'ai-insights';` (anchored) | 1 | **0** |
| `AIInsightsSchema` in `dist/index.d.ts` re-export list | 1 | **0** |
| control `interface AIRecommendationsSchema` / member `type: 'ai-recommendations';` / barrel | 1 / 1 / 1 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| external-consumer probe (`import type { AIInsightsSchema, AIRecommendationsSchema } from '<dist>/index.js'`, tsc outside the repo tsconfig) | exit 0 | **exit 2, exactly one error: TS2305 has no exported member 'AIInsightsSchema'**; the sibling import raised none |

⚠️ For whoever re-greps dist later: a bare `grep 'ai-insights' dist` on the head scores 3 and `AIInsightsSchema` scores 2 — all four lines are inside the emitted tombstone JSDoc in `dist/ai.d.ts` (lines 516–575, every one leading with ` *`), not declarations. The PR's "0 / 0 / 0" is the anchored reading and it holds. The `ai.ts` tombstone does travel into `dist/ai.d.ts` as the PR claims; the `index.ts` comment does not (comments inside an export list are not emitted) — the PR only claimed the former.

**Deletion vs `?: never` tombstone — judged, not assumed.** Deletion is right here, and the tombstone convention does not require otherwise:

- The `?: never` tombstone is a **member-level** device, and objectui#8178 adopted it for a stated, member-specific reason: the three schemas extend `BaseSchema`, which carries `[key: string]: any`, so a *deleted member* is absorbed silently at any value and the ruling's compile-time-refusal pin was unsatisfiable by deletion. That reason has no analogue for a whole exported type — a module namespace has no index signature, and a missing export is a hard TS2305, measured above on both dist builds (error on head, clean on base).
- The repo's **whole-type** precedent is objectui#4895 (`blocks.ts`): the family's interfaces were deleted outright, the module was kept as a comment tombstone (`export {}`), `index.ts` says the re-export block is "GONE, not emptied", and `block-family-retired-4895.test.ts` pins the names out. This diff has the same three parts (comment tombstone in `ai.ts`, "GONE from this block, not emptied out of it" at the barrel, executable pin). The one shape difference — the new pin deliberately omits #4895's runtime `name in module` leg — is correct, because `AIInsightsSchema` was `export type` only and that leg could not distinguish before from after; the pin says so.
- The name-preserving alternative (`export type AIInsightsSchema = never`) would keep the symbol on the published `.d.ts`, contradicting the ruling's words "the declaration and its barrel export go" and the card's whole point (a `.d.ts` that lists only renderable node types). It would narrow *less* than ruled. What landed narrows neither more nor less than ruled.

**The objectui#8178 pin rewrite — authorised, and nothing else moved.** The ruling names that file and those two lines and says the pin "is rewritten by this ruling, ⛔ not by refactor". Its stated ground at base ("the ruling names three schemas and that fourth one was neither screened nor decided") is discharged by #8800 exactly as the replacement paragraph says. I diffed the file at `3ecc369bf..52bdbe331`: one hunk, lines 112–124, +21/−6 — the paragraph and the single `Expect<Equal<…>>` alias. `Equal` / `Expect` remain defined and used by the seven `?: never` assertions (lines 94–100) and the three live-member controls (109–111); the seven tombstones, the suggestions/recommendations fixtures and the control `describe` blocks are byte-identical to base. That is objectui#8178's retirement left whole, and this is the only file of #8178's that the ruling reaches — the diff does not touch `packages/plugin-ai/**` or the #8178 changeset.

### ② Semver and changeset — verified on the built artifact

- **Level.** `'@object-ui/types': minor`. Correct for this repository: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (AGENTS.md §版本号策略) refuses `major` because all 39 publishable packages sit in one `fixed` group pinned to `@objectstack`'s major; breaking changes ship `minor` with the break spelled out in the body. The body carries the **BREAKING** banner, the FROM (`import type { AIInsightsSchema }` / `{ type: 'ai-insights', … }`) → TO (nothing; delete the node), and the one-line fix, and names every removed member. The break is real on the published surface — TS2305 on the head dist, clean on the base dist, above. Ran at the head: `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-fixed` 0, `check-changeset-claims` 0; CI `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` all success.
- **Package set.** `@object-ui/types` alone — correct: it is the only package whose `dist/**.d.ts` changed contents on the published face (no transitive `export *` of it anywhere; the fixed group carries the bump to the family regardless).
- **Disposition line — recorded, non-blocking.** The ruling's execution line asks for "the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition line". The changeset carries `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and the PR calls that the disposition line. In the only grammar that defines the term (objectstack `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, closed vocabulary `unpublished | already-registered | no-migration-prescription | runtime-interface-only | type-surface-only`, marker `adr-0087:`), the Clause-② line and the ADR-0087 disposition are two distinct markers that sit together; this body has the first and not the second. The honest marker for a TS-only type with no zod mirror and no objectstack ledger entry would be `adr-0087: type-surface-only`. I do not fail on it: this repository has no gate or ledger that reads the marker (measured — no `check:adr-0087-registration` script here), the ruling's other clause ("as objectui#8178 did") points at a precedent whose changeset carries no such marker either (nor does #4895's), and the impact itself is declared completely and correctly, which is what ② judges. A one-line addition to the body would close the gap.
- **Pending-record accuracy, non-blocking.** `.changeset/8178-ai-schemas-retire-zero-read-members.md` (pending, will publish in the same release) still says of `AIInsightsSchema.objectName`: "A pin holds it at `string | undefined` so a later sweep … cannot take it quietly." This diff made that sentence false (the pin is gone by ruling). `check-changeset-claims` did not raise it because the paragraph names no file; the 8800 body in the same CHANGELOG states the pin was rewritten, so a reader is not misled about the surface, but the sentence is a WENT-FALSE claim of exactly the shape that gate exists for. A prose-only correction of that paragraph is precedented (`check-changeset-overwrite` case 2) and would not exceed the ruling, which governs the pin, not the prose. Recommended, not required for this verdict. (The one claim the re-read bot did flag, `6051` on `packages/types/src/index.ts` / `GanttConfig`, is still true: `GanttConfig,` remains exported at `index.ts:434` and in `dist/index.d.ts`.)

### ③ Boundary flags — each answered or escalated
